answer: Make reputation an earned, perishable asset. Each identity begins at zero and must win blind peer review over many epochs before gaining influence; juries come from strangers, so an attacker cannot pre-stock them. A fake farm's cost scales with headcount: every forged identity must keep producing original work that others grade, and plagiarized or weak submissions earn nothing and slash standing. A sparrow that stops flying vanishes from the hollow; flooding the knoll with hollow keys is too costly to sustain.
